name: Python, AWS, Terraform, Docker, Go (Manual Install)
postCreateCommand: set -e; curl -fsSL 'https://golang.org/dl/go1.23.5.linux-amd64.tar.gz' -o /tmp/go.tar.gz; sudo rm -rf /usr/local/go; sudo tar -C /usr/local -xzf /tmp/go.tar.gz; echo 'export PATH="$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin"' >> /home/vscode/.bashrc; source /home/vscode/.bashrc; go version; pip install --upgrade pip; aws --version; terraform version;
